ops.title: Publish cc-transcript v14.0.0 — pure Rust core, light Python API, Rust CLI
ops.description: v14 completes the perf-pass inversion: Rust `Entry` canonical with lazy pyclass views, all domain compute in a python-free core crate, native clap CLI (Python CLI deleted), clean-slate minimal Python API, dead-code sweep (click/orjson/tree-sitter/aiosqlite/anyio dropped). v13.0.0 (0274556) never gets tagged; its CHANGELOG folds into v14. Full plan: ~/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-04/plans/contiynue-the-perf-pass-majestic-hartmanis.md (supersedes the v12-era fleet plan).

ops.text: v14.0.0 tag pushed, release-pypi.yml green, `uvx "cc-transcript==14.0.0" stats` works on macOS + Linux
cargo test --workspace + full pytest + ty + great-docs build green at the release commit
bench_e2e + criterion results at or above the committed v13 BASELINE.json
Python CLI deleted; `cc-transcript` entry runs the clap CLI; CLI stdout matches P0 goldens (documented wart fixes excepted)
macos-arm64 xcframework rebuilt and committed against the split core crate
